compiled_state.title: [plugins/dso/scripts/onboarding/dso-setup.sh]: full-init install ignores Socratic dialog opt-outs -> writes artifacts the user declined
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Background

Split from umbrella bug 5d92-105c-a047-4d07 (which remains OPEN as an epic-shaped 'provider/toolchain-blind' setup overhaul). The umbrella tracks Defects A–G; this ticket covers **Defect A** alone — the only sub-defect that is bounded enough to ship as a single-commit bug-fix without the full epic.

## Defect A scope

`dso-setup.sh` runs a Socratic dialog (per onboarding SKILL.md) that asks the user which artifacts to install: CI workflows, hooks, ticket tracker, host project template, etc. On the "full-init" install path, the script installs the full bundle **regardless** of which artifacts the user opted out of during the dialog. The opt-out signals are ignored.

This is distinct from Defects B–G (which concern the deeper toolchain-blindness — hardcoded Python/Poetry/GitHub Actions/Jira assumptions). Defect A is purely about honoring the dialog answers that the script already has: read them, and skip the install of any artifact the user said 'no' to.

## Proposed fix

1. Identify where the Socratic dialog stores its answers (likely a per-section state variable or a temp file consumed downstream by dso-setup.sh).
2. Gate each per-artifact install block in dso-setup.sh on the corresponding dialog answer: `if [[ "$opt_install_ci" == 'yes' ]]; then ...; fi`, repeated for hooks/tracker/host-template.
3. Add a behavioral test: drive dso-setup.sh with a scripted set of dialog answers (`no` for each opted-out artifact) and assert the corresponding files are absent post-run.

## Why split

The full umbrella (5d92-105c-a047-4d07) requires multi-skill coordination (provider.* config namespace, onboarding SKILL.md dialog changes, per-stack template variants, integration tests per provider × stack). Defect A does not require any of that — it is a bounded gating change in one script, with one test fixture. Shipping A independently restores user trust in the dialog while the larger refactor is scoped.

## References

* Umbrella: 5d92-105c-a047-4d07 (provider/toolchain-blind setup epic-shaped work)
* Affected: plugins/dso/scripts/onboarding/dso-setup.sh; plugins/dso/skills/onboarding/SKILL.md (dialog answer storage)
